policy.decision_stage: chosen after development comparisons, before test outcomes; not retrospective preregistration
policy.prediction_tie: score exactly 0.5 predicts inactive, matching sklearn logistic decision > 0
policy.ranking_status: illustrative candidate budgets fixed before inspecting P@k; not a validated lab budget
policy.ranking_ties: round probabilities to 12 decimals; expected hits from uniform selection within a boundary tie
policy.family_representative: highest rounded probability; ties choose lexicographically smallest sequence+amidation identity, ignoring labels

local_alignment.identity_denominator: all alignment columns including internal gaps
local_alignment.coverage_denominator: aligned residue pairs divided by peptide length; report both peptides
local_alignment.tie_policy: scan up to 100 score-optimal alignments; an incomplete tie scan excludes the test identity from local/combined strict subsets

subsets.global60_strict: maximum direct global edit similarity to training is strictly below 0.60
subsets.local60_strict: no detected coverage-qualified score-optimal local match has identity >=0.60; all optimal-alignment tie scans complete

policy.primary_analysis: primary model, original overall test; subsets and other models are secondary, not selection rules

final_intervals.method: paired percentile whole-80pct-family bootstrap of fixed test predictions
final_intervals.one_class_draws: omit consistently across compared models; disclose counts; suppress interval if >10% omitted

policy.small_subsets: always report n, classes and families; AUROC undefined with one class; suppress AUROC intervals below declared support limits
policy.clinical_analysis: 17 clinical-only identities are exploratory; only three inactive; do not use clinical buffer for training or selection
policy.selection_rule: evaluate the fixed list once; select no feature set, C, cutoff or grouping threshold from test/clinical performance
policy.power: 71 test identities in 47 families provide a limited final check, not a powered ranking of small feature-set differences; no promised CI width

neighbor_summary.subset_class_counts: not computed: held-out outcomes remain sealed

notes: No fitted model was changed or selected from held-out outcomes.
This is a development-informed pre-test protocol, not preregistration before training.
Local similarity is a diagnostic under declared scoring/coverage rules, not proof of homology or independence.
OOF precision intervals are conditional, selection-affected database diagnostics, not prospective wet-lab success rates.
